business_problem: analyze thousands of long customer-service calls at reasonable cost so the business could understand intent, sentiment, and service pain points at scale.
solution_summary: Jet2 uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to analyze thousands of long customer-service calls at reasonable cost so the business could understand intent, sentiment, and service pain points at scale. Thousands of daily call transcripts from Jet2 contact centers are stored and analyzed in Snowflake to reveal customer intent, preferences, and pain points. Cortex AI supports the core summarization and classification workflow, and Jet2 maintains an LLMOps framework to tune performance and hold down cost as prompts and classifications evolve. Analysts and service leaders use the outputs to improve customer service, and the same framework is being extended to other communications and self-service insight use cases across the company. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications. Jet2 deployed its first LLM use case in three months,...
